title: haven.butler-purpose-graph.v1
description: E1 alternative B design contract, not an implemented cell or a completed WP8 agreement. WP8 must adopt this exact import/export payload before source handover. See E1-KART.md and E1-MIGRERING-TIL-REGISTER.md.

node.description: Existing purpose node fields are retained. Non-leaves require composition semantically; omission is a migration warning in purpose_dev validate. childOrder lists all direct children once and is required for sequence and firstOf. No composition default.

bookNode.description: Book 23 fields unchanged, including goal.goalRef, matchingHints.aliases/tokens and optional ref aliases. No Butler consumer parameters here. Upstream composition definitions copied as-is; extensions preserved, not inferred.

sourceRef.description: Preserve Book sourceRefs, including historical checkedAt; migration time does not replace source provenance.

knowledgeBase.description: Whole declared Book/register snapshot, including schemaRef, facets, compatibility and nodeDefaults unchanged. E1 does not reconcile the runtime taxonomy or infer parents.

endpointHint.description: Literal local endpoint OR closed binding to existing AdminControlPlaneRouting.current.endpoint(for:) code. No host, credentials, function name or expression supplied by data. Resolve once in pinned environment input. Preserve the baseline static-lexicon initialization phase/lifetime for resolved bindings; do not re-read mutable routing configuration per analysis. Pin the resulting environment snapshot.

helper_invite.description: lowercased; negation first; listExclusions only affect addPhrases. Original-text regex and boolean returns remain code.

helper_poll.description: lowercased; negation and two global exclusions; groupChoice OR (cannotAgree AND alternative); exact token/prefix fallback.

helper_videoMeeting.description: lowercased; negation then direct, expanded, call AND immediate, device; first return, otherwise zero.

helper_scheduleMeeting.description: lowercased; negation; meeting AND scheduling before explicit phrase. schedule meeting remains 0.84, never max over branches.

helper_project.description: lowercased; negation and publish exclusions stop all; project AND work, general project, workspace in that order.

helper_ideaCapture.description: nb_NO folding/lowercase; negation then capture, note, token fallback with local no-idea exclusion.

helper_todo.description: lowercased; AI exclusion before negation. generic, list, remember, delegate; todo list stays 0.78.

helper_reminder.description: lowercased; negation, direct, then (notify OR loseTrack) AND mentionsClockTime. notify wins overlap; clock predicate stays code.

helper_guidedOnboarding.description: normalizedAssistantText; negation then gateway AND explicitSetup AND (!status OR strongSetup), questionnaire AND setup, modelNotConnected AND !status, gettingStarted AND !otherSurface, onboarding AND conference, onboarding. All exception scopes and order stay code.

hva kan co-piloten hjelpe meg med
hva kan copiloten hjelpe meg med

what can you help me with
what can haven do for me

helper_capabilityDiscoveryOnboarding.description: normalizedAssistantText; one phrases list for suppression markers and positive match; score or zero.

helper_advisoryReport.description: normalizedAssistantText; negation, panel, short assessment phrase/prefix, advisor AND (assessment OR report), advisor, assessment AND report, assessment. First return; prefix remains anchored.

helper_uncertainGoalClarification.description: normalizedAssistantText; negation, strong phrases, uncertainty AND goal words; otherwise zero.

examples: er det mulig å få til
er det mulig a fa til

helper_capabilityGap.description: lowercased; negation, explicit gap, other gap phrases, desire AND product; otherwise zero.

helper_workItem.description: normalizedAssistantText; negation, capture, product AND failure, fix phrases with product-dependent score. All order remains code.

helper_moderation.description: lowercased; phrase match or zero. Baseline has no negation guard; E1 must not add one.

rule_profilePublish.description: Exact purpose/endpoint; personal.profile.page.create OR personal.public-presence.publish; max(score, floor).

rule_configurationAuthoring.description: Exact; purpose://capability.construct-cellconfiguration; normalized name cell configuration architect: max(score + add, floor); else ai agent workspace: min(score, workspaceCap).

rule_activityDashboard.description: Exact; dashboard routing purpose AND exact combinedConfigurationName; max(score + add, floor).

rule_adminOperations.description: Exact; admin.scaffold-operations.observe; admin control plane overview: add then floor; else admin copilot workspace OR admin cell dashboard: cap.

rule_adminCleanup.description: Exact; admin.cell-lifecycle.cleanup-review; admin cell dashboard: add then floor; else admin copilot workspace: cap.

rule_aiGateway.description: Exact; personal.ai.gateway.configure; normalized name ai agent workspace OR normalized endpoint contains cell aigateway; add then floor.

rule_kallimachosAdvisor.description: Exact; knowledge.demo.kallimachos; endpoint equals KallimachosAdvisorContract.endpoint case-insensitively; add then floor.

rule_adminCredential.description: Exact; admin.identity.vc.request; normalized name access requirement prompt OR endpoint contains cell accessrequirementprompt; add then floor.

rule_arendalsukaIntroduction.description: Exact; arendalsuka.companion.introduce; publisher endpoint: add then floor; else EventAtlas: cap.

rule_arendalsukaParticipant.description: Exact; text contains arendalsuka AND isArendalsukaParticipantPurpose; publisher: add then floor; else EventAtlas AND !mentionsArendalsukaAtlasMaintenance: cap. May follow S10.

rule_dashboardAfterLexicon.description: After loop if dashboard intent matched; exact combinedConfigurationName: floor; else architect: cap. Not inside S04.

rule_artistSalesAfterLexicon.description: After P01; exact ArtistSales endpoint; artTerms substring in normalized prompt: floor, otherwise cap. Context boost follows.

lexicon.description: Ordered; every one of the 27 entryIDs exactly once. Reordering changes identity and requires evaluation. New entries require a schema/runtime contract revision.

x-contentHash.input: JCS({"schema": document.schema, "content": document.content}) encoded as UTF-8, no BOM or trailing newline
x-contentHash.output: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex digits
x-contentHash.included: All content: nodes, source provenance, complete ordered lists, consumer parameter names and values, runtime contract versions and sourceCommit. No default insertion, array sorting, ref rewriting or string normalization.
x-contentHash.excluded: Only root contentHash. Mutable pointers, approvals, reports, receipts, environment endpoint resolutions and entity-owned learning are outside this document.

x-semanticValidation: Reject duplicate object keys, invalid Unicode, non-finite numbers, unknown consumer fields and runtime contract versions.
Reject missing/duplicate lexicon entryIDs, empty phrases and empty token groups. endpointHints=[] is valid. Each of the 27 entryIDs must occur once.
Validate unique node purposeRefs, root/parents, declared composition and facet semantics against the pinned upstream contract. Never derive edges from ref text.
Noncanonical routing refs remain only in the Butler facet. Never manufacture purpose:// aliases, parentRefs or Goals.
Validate contentHash, schema/dependency artifact hashes, runtime compatibility and catalog bindings before publishing an immutable version.
No person nodes, entity weights, messages or learning events in graph import. Content/privacy validation is required beyond JSON Schema.
Require 0 <= render <= suggest <= autofill <= 1 and 0 < candidateTieTolerance <= 1. Operations and phases stay in code.
